summary: Generates PCM wave tables for engine-sound synthesis. Two paths selected by the quality selector at +0x117: values above 8 build a multi-channel 16-bit table array (interpolated or direct fill depending on the mode word at +0x60), values at or below 8 build a 256-byte mono ramp table. Table memory is allocated through sub_517E92; samples are converted with CRTFtol and normalized through read-only double constants. The raw source references an additional per-shift lookup table not present in the packet globals.

operations.description: Require the float enable flag at +0x130 to be non-zero; when zero the entire table generation body is skipped.
Branch on the quality selector byte at +0x117: values above 8 take the multi-channel 16-bit path, values at or below 8 take the 256-byte mono ramp path.
Multi-channel path: when bit 0x2 of the byte at +0x116 is set, use the maximum of the three per-channel amplitude bytes at +0x150, +0x151 and +0x152; otherwise use the mean amplitude byte at +0x153.

Derive the quantization shift: start at 16 minus the chosen amplitude, enforce a floor of 5 when bit 0x4 of the byte at +0x61 is set, clamp to the range 0..8, store it at +0x12C, and compute the table entry count as 1 << (8 - shift).
Allocate the per-entry pointer array via sub_517E92(a1, 4 * entry_count) and store the result at +0x144.
Branch on the mode word at +0x60: when bit 0x480 is clear the table array is filled by the interpolated path; when set, by the direct path.

Interpolated path: for each entry, allocate a 512-slot sub-table via sub_517E92(a1, 512); each of its 512 16-bit samples is produced from a phase value advanced by 256 per step and scaled by 1/65536, converted with CRTFtol(sample * 65535.0 + 0.5) after calling sub_5881F0; the phase step comes from a per-shift lookup scaled by 256.
Read the double-precision constants at 0x0059E420, 0x0059E430 and 0x0059E880 used as normalization coefficients in the sample-generation arithmetic.

Direct path: allocate one 512-slot sub-table per entry via sub_517E92(a1, 512), storing each pointer into the +0x144 array; then fill all entries from a normalized ramp, converting positions with CRTFtol after calling sub_5881F0, and pad the remainder of each sub-table with -1 (0xFFFF).
Read the double-precision constants at 0x005AF430, 0x005AF438, 0x005AF440 and 0x005AF448 used in the multi-channel fill arithmetic.
Mono path: allocate a 256-byte mono table via sub_517E92(a1, 256) and store the pointer at +0x138.
Mono path: fill 256 byte entries, each computed as CRTFtol(index * 0.00392156862745098 * 255.0 + 0.5) after calling sub_5881F0 with the normalized index.
